notes.title: Version 2.0 Update！
notes.content:
Version 2.0 Update: New Anomalies and Improved Game Hints

Details:
1. Added 5 brand-new anomalies, each highly visible or with jump-scare elements (also removed 5 inconspicuous or irrelevant anomalies, making the game easier after this update. Note: If this isn’t your first playthrough and you want to see these new additions, make sure to enable “Reset Anomalies” to view the new content correctly).
2. Added hints to text sections, including new hints on the newspaper at the ending to help ensure you don’t miss these texts.
3. Fixed several in-game bugs.

If you encounter any issues, please let me know. : )

notes.title: 10.17Update
notes.content:
This update mainly adjusts some inconspicuous anomalies to make them more prominent.
Subsequent considerations will gradually replace these minor anomalies with anomalies that have performance effects or startling elements.

notes.title: 10.16Update
notes.content:
It is best to reset the exception before starting the game in this update
1. This update also fixes the bug of refreshing duplicate exceptions, and now the exceptions you find can be saved correctly. As long as you don't reset the exceptions, you won't encounter the ones you've already seen when starting a new game next time.
2.When you are on the second floor now, the chance of encountering anomalies will be reduced by half compared to normal, making it easier and faster to complete the game.
